host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the gdbserver to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces (not recommended for untrusted networks).

port.description: TCP port number for gdbserver to listen on. Must be between 1 and 65535.

extended_remote.description: Enable extended-remote mode, allowing the debugger to attach/detach without restarting the target. Recommended for most debugging scenarios.

attach_pid.description: Process ID (PID) to attach to instead of launching a new program. If set, the 'program' argument is ignored. Set to null (unset) to launch a new process.

processes.description: List of processes to manage or attach to in multi-mode (for advanced orchestration). Each entry specifies a process by name and optional PID.

name.description: Friendly name for the process (for documentation only).

pid.description: Process ID to attach to. Leave null if launching from this config.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass directly to gdbserver. Examples: '--no-stop' (do not stop at entry), '--wrapper' (use an interpreter/wrapper script). Use sparingly.
